name: Hiiragi Haru
source:
"[i]I beg you—please turn me into a magical girl once again.[/i]"

Taiga’s childhood friend, a transfer student, and a [b]former magical girl[/b].

She was one of the participants in the grand battle that happened several years back.
With no family of her own, she lived in a care facility for some time,
but was eventually taken in by foster parents and left the town.
This spring, she returns to the town as a transfer student.

She is naturally a shy person,
but she never shows that side of herself
in front of anyone except Taiga.
In his mind, Taiga secretly refers to her as a slightly cute yet stubborn girl.

It is said that Hiiragi Haru has a [b]dream[/b] that she absolutely must make come true.
In order to fulfill that dream,
she wishes to become a [b]magical girl[/b] once more, but...

[b]Profile[/b]
[i]Height[/i]: 157cm
[i]Measurements[/i]: B89 / W57 / H88
[i]Favorite food[/i]: Sweet snacks on the higher side of calories. She especially likes taiyaki.
[i]Blood type[/i]: B
[i]Birthday[/i]: March 21st

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]

[spoiler]She wants to return to being a magical girl so that she can save a certain person[/spoiler]
[spoiler]She is [url=/c106928]Tooya(遠矢)[/url]'s granddaughter[/spoiler]
